theorem exists_simultaneous_one (n : Nat)
    (p q : MvPolynomial (Fin n) (ZMod 2))
    (hdeg : p.totalDegree + q.totalDegree <= n)
    (hcoeff : (p * q).coeff (∑ i : Fin n, Finsupp.single i 1) = 1) :
    ∃ x : Fin n → ZMod 2,
      MvPolynomial.eval x p = 1 ∧ MvPolynomial.eval x q = 1 := by
